name: SaunaLife GL4 | 4-Person Outdoor Sauna Kit | Glass Front
description: Description Bring Scandinavian luxury to your backyard with the SaunaLife Garden Luxury-Series Model GL4 Outdoor Home Sauna Kit. Expertly crafted with professional-grade materials and designed for effortless at-home assembly, the GL4 combines striking architectural beauty with superior performance. Its modern, full-glass front and integrated porch create an inviting retreat, while ultra-premium Nordic Thermo-Spruce and Thermo-Aspen components ensure unmatched comfort, durability, and weather resistance. With easy two-day DIY installation, ambient LED lighting, and Wi-Fi smart controls, the GL4 makes luxury outdoor sauna living both accessible and achievable. Features Premium 1.57" thick Nordic Thermo-Spruce walls for enhanced durability and longevity Modern architectural design with horizontal eaves, black trim, and integrated porch for a sleek, contemporary look Full bronze tempered-glass front (5/16” thick) with reversible door and full-height handle for open views and privacy Contoured 2-tier benching and backrest made of extra-thick, silky-smooth Thermo-Aspen for luxurious comfort Full-width recessed LED lighting integrated in porch eaves for elegant exterior illumination Indirect interior LED lighting with dimmable settings controlled via Wi-Fi app or wireless remote Engineered for pro-quality DIY installation in just 2 days with 2 people Interlocking-beam construction supports natural wood movement and ensures long-term stability What's Included?
